meta.why: Rung 1 (scout_still) resolves: the natural cover is the Scout-verified ETH Zurich night panorama (sct_eth) — a real, license-clean landmark with NO recognizable public figure (buildings only), so any video model is safe and no Kling is needed. Rung 0 does NOT apply: the Editor placed the centerpiece reweighter at edt_06, not the teaser (editor.json.interactives.hero.section == 'edt_06'), so this is a normal animated cover, not the interactive-hero passthrough. The ultra-wide 10060x2636 source was 16:9-cropped from the ORIGINAL, centered on the lit domed rotunda, into a crisp 1280x720 hero frame (large black night-sky band kept on top for the headline scrim). RENDER NOTE (honest): image2video was invoked at rung 1, but the OpenRouter video endpoint returned HTTP 402 'Insufficient credits' for BOTH the Veo primary (google/veo-3.1-fast) and the Seedance fallback (bytedance/seedance-2.0), so the pipeline's sanctioned ffmpeg Ken-Burns + boomerang motion fallback rendered the cover from the SAME verified ETH still (FALLBACK_USED=kenburns). This is still an ANIMATED <video> cover (kind:video), NOT the static rung-5 fallback: a clearly-visible centered ~12% push-in toward the lit dome (PRIMARY motion) plus a subtle warm-light breathing at 0.5 Hz / 3 whole cycles over 6 s (SECONDARY, on the designer's 'window-lights flicker gently' brief), post-processed into a seamless forward+reverse boomerang. No AI model produced the motion, so source.model is null and source.fallback_used is 'kenburns' (not fabricated as a clean AI render). Web-weight cover: webm 0.44 MB + mp4 1.23 MB = 1.69 MB < 3 MB.

source.prompt: Cinemagraph, motion-only. PRIMARY: a slow, steady cinematic push-in toward the lit domed central rotunda. SECONDARY: the warm interior window-lights and the glowing arched windows shimmer and softly pulse like real incandescent light; the forecourt street-lamp halos bloom and twinkle; thin atmospheric night haze drifts slowly across the empty plaza. HELD PERFECTLY STILL: the neoclassical stone building, its columns, arches and dome geometry stay rigid with no warping and no camera shake -- only the light, the haze and the slow push-in move. Deep black night sky, calm nocturne mood. [Submitted to image2video; the AI models refused with HTTP 402 insufficient credits, so the realized motion is the ffmpeg Ken-Burns subset: a centered ~12% push-in + a gentle warm-light breathing, boomeranged.]

hero.disclosure: Image = a real Wikimedia Commons photograph of ETH Zurich's Hauptgebaude (a fetched, identity-verified still, not AI). Motion = a slow camera push-in and a gentle warm-light animation added to the still via ffmpeg (Ken-Burns boomerang) because the AI video endpoint was unavailable; this is not AI video and not of any real person.

build_contract._who: The Hero SPECS this; the Programmer builds it; validate.py Section 12 asserts it. Do NOT edit the frozen verify engine.
build_contract.video_tag: <video webm+mp4+poster autoplay loop muted playsinline> using assets/teaser.webm (VP9) + assets/teaser_web.mp4 (H.264) + poster=assets/teaser.jpg. Keep the loop attribute (the clip is a seamless boomerang).
build_contract.cin_stage_wrap: Wrap the cover in .cin-stage. Cinematic-ON: it IS the cin_00 layer of the live cinematic stage (Cinematographer stages sct_eth as cin_00). Cinematic-OFF: a degenerate <div class='cin-stage hero-only-stage'> that still paints assets/teaser.jpg as backdrop. Either way isDecorative() (el.closest('.cin-stage')) auto-excludes the cover from Verify -- no verify-engine edit.
build_contract.reduced_motion: A reduced-motion fallback is ALWAYS in the DOM; under prefers-reduced-motion / JS-off it shows and autoplay never fires.
build_contract.autoplay_retry: Keep autoplay muted loop playsinline. Additionally wire a JS video.play() retry on the first user gesture (bind a one-time handler to pointerdown/touchstart/keydown/click + scroll/wheel/touchmove, mirroring the BGM sndKick pattern; remove listeners only on a resolved .play() promise). If .play() rejects, reveal a centred tap-to-play glyph over the cover that calls video.play() on click. Skip the retry under prefers-reduced-motion.
build_contract.single_teaser_hit: Exactly ONE .teaser overlay carries data-des='des_hero_video' -- the cover's single Verify hit. All decorative furniture (scrim, stat strip, kicker rule, vignette) is pointer-events:none with NO data-* so the Verify engine ignores it.
build_contract.provenance_prefix: Reuse data-des='des_hero_video' -- mint NO new provenance prefix.
